svg.title: The Paddock family
svg.desc: Pitcrew, Sighter, Debrief, Pitwall, Dyno and Spotter, six local-first desktop apps, connected by a few hand-offs and built on the shared Paddock foundation.
svg.text: Six local-first tools for people who keep systems running
Built on one foundation, each good alone, better together.

g.text: The shared foundation under every app.
